# Awakenology AI workspace

This folder contains repository-local material specifically used to guide or support AI-assisted work on Awakenology.

## What belongs here

- AI operating instructions and project-specific prompt guidance.
- AI-facing indexes and source-backed knowledge references.
- Terminology and conceptual reference pointers used during AI-assisted editing, analysis, and development.

## What belongs elsewhere

- General internal working material, private test fixtures, unpublished drafts, operational setup notes, and project records belong in `Internal/`.
- GitHub Actions workflows remain in `.github/workflows/`.
- Engineering tests, scripts, and technical documentation remain in `tests/`, `scripts/`, and their existing documentation locations.
- Public, approved Awakenology content remains in its existing public content folders.

## Current references

- [Directionality of Hypnosis and Awakenosis](./DIRECTIONALITY-PRINCIPLES.md) — working conceptual note; preserve its open questions and do not silently revise course formulas.
- [Terminology glossary pointer](./TERMINOLOGY-GLOSSARY.md) — compatibility pointer to the unified trilingual glossary.

## Source-of-truth rule

- `Awakenology-Glossary/Terminology.md` is the single source of truth for the unified trilingual terminology glossary.
- `TERMINOLOGY-GLOSSARY.md` in this folder is a compatibility pointer only. Do not recreate a separate glossary here.
- Do not maintain duplicate copies of source material. Link to the authoritative source where possible.

Keep this folder focused on AI-specific guidance and knowledge, not as a catch-all for every non-public repository file.
